subject: Deployed App gets "Error: Timeout was reached" when loading WFS from geoserver

messages.author: 2d9924156af1cbe3
messages.subject: Deployed App gets "Error: Timeout was reached" when loading WFS from geoserver
parts:
I'm trying to deploy an app, that loads data from geoserver and displays it in a table and in a leaflet map.
When i run it locally, everything works out fine, but as soon as the app is deployed on shinyapps.io i get the time out error. (picture)

In my server.R i have the following code snippet that throws such an error.

output$printdns <- renderPrint({
   dsn <- "http://geoserveripadress:8080/geoserver/Destinationen/ows?service=WFS&version=1.0.0&request=getCapabilities"
   getCapab <- GET(dsn)
   cat(paste("\nGetCapab:", str(getCapab )))
})

and in the ui.R somewhere:
verbatimTextOutput("printdns")

The geoserver is running locally on my machine, so the geoserverip is actually my ipadress.

I have allowed the port 8080 in my firewall, but no change.

I'm not so sure where the problem is; shinyapps, geoserver configs, ip /port problem?

Any ideas?

Thanks in advance!

messages.subject: Re: Deployed App gets "Error: Timeout was reached" when loading WFS from geoserver
parts:
A private address is not accessible from a different network.
You need a public IP address in order to access your server from shinyapps.io

On Tuesday, July 11, 2017 at 6:00:51 PM UTC-4, Sebastian_G wrote:
